decision: Select AT-adhd-features-106 as the smallest bounded missing owner gate. No source admission is granted by this plan.

selectedAssertion.sourceAssertion: - **AT-adhd-features-106 [R0]** Given dependency lock and adapter decision records, When least-fragile-tool validation runs, Then canonical pins/proven owner interfaces are used, no feature scheduler/blocker/credential store or runtime download appears, and unproven alternatives remain blocked.

whyThisCard.gap: The indexed CLI assertion is unregistered. Existing EngineeringControl.garden is public and checks generic K2/foundation rules and feature-map consistency, but has no ADHD-specific dependency/owner/forbidden-tool check; @toy/adhd currently has only @toy/contracts as a direct dependency and its public.ts only re-exports ModuleId. Existing EngineeringControl.checkResearch readback shows actual M08 ADHD planning alternatives BLOCKED with no selected tool and missing G0:R0:M08. Thus current generic garden/research checks do not provide this assigned source-bound compatibility oracle.
whyThisCard.whyNot66: AT-adhd-features-66 requires per-feature requirement/quote/grill coverage and primary research evidence; the generic comparison owner does not prove that coverage, and no compact source-bound feature-comparison result is present.
whyThisCard.whyNot67: AT-adhd-features-67 requires actual authenticated provider receipts, wire-mapping evidence, and the reviewed research-skill/report revision; the verified generic route/skill owner readback does not prove this protected provider/account case.
whyThisCard.noClaim: This gate cannot certify ADHD feature behavior, complete research, provider authentication, device/account prerequisites, full R0, or protected native acceptance.

minimumOwnerInterface.existingOwner: EngineeringControl.garden through SelfImprovement.registeredProbe / TestProbeControl and the existing public CLI; reuse EngineeringControl.checkResearch for the real M08 blocked-state readback.
minimumOwnerInterface.change: Extend the existing garden report with three source-derived CheckViews for canonical lock/owner mapping, absence of ADHD-local scheduler/blocker/credential-store/runtime-download mechanisms, and the actual M08 unproven-alternative BLOCKED readback. Route one registered case through the existing SelfImprovement probe entry point and return the existing GardenerReportV1/CheckViewV1 DTOs. Do not add a command, contract, DTO, schema, module, store, protocol, or feature implementation.

Never translate that BLOCKED state into an ADHD research-admission PASS.

finiteCases.publicOwner: EngineeringControl.garden plus actual EngineeringControl.checkResearch M08 readback
assertions: The package lock and ADHD manifest resolve to canonical declared owners/interfaces; reject an unpinned or undeclared first-party dependency.
The ADHD-owned manifest/source tree contains no feature-local scheduler, blocker, credential store, or runtime-downloader mechanism.
The indexed M08 comparison remains BLOCKED with selectedTool null and its current missing validation ID; no caller flag or synthetic overlay can turn it into PASS.
finiteCases.mutationOracle: Fail closed from the source-derived lock/owner and forbidden-mechanism predicates; the decisive negative oracle is the actual indexed M08 BLOCKED result. Do not claim mutation coverage from synthetic case strings. A disposable-worktree mutation suite is outside this 2-hour card unless the owner can prove it is necessary and keep it within the same three CLI-attempt ceiling.
